# Corpus-first source experiment

Informed development on 2026-09-29, following the user request to prioritize
corpus implementation over further general proof infrastructure. The prior
sized-Xor source, 30 finite translations, current hierarchical circuit
producer, native checker and Fourier host work were known. No external model
was invoked; this is not a controlled model benchmark. These sources were
saved before their first experimental compilation. The compiler is untrusted,
with explicit native reconstruction and separate numerical algorithm tests.
The snapshot retains the initial Xor and GHZ sources together; GHZ is new
authoring, Xor adapts the already preserved source to this bounded experiment.
